make_executable_function: make_executable decorator transforms a function into an Executable that can be awaited or iterated
run_executables_parallel: run executables in parallel using the parallel or par_iter functions with configurable chunk sizes
chain_executables_serially: chain executables serially using the serial or ser_iter functions to execute them one after another
stream_executable_updates: stream intermediate updates from an executable using safe_stream or stream_with_callback context managers
set_parallel_execution_limit: set the default maximum number of parallel executions using set_max_parallel_executions or max_parallel_executions context manager
